Laya is built to make AI decisions, not generate paragraphs.

Built by Indian developer Nandakishor Mukkunnoth, this open-source decision engine can handle tasks like spam detection, content moderation, and AI model routing in milliseconds.

It’s self-hostable, lightweight, and designed to handle simple decisions without using an expensive LLM for every request.

For AI agents and automation workflows, this could be a very useful building block.
